scripts.text:
- Please stop here!! -
- You have carried too much items, -
- Therefore unable receive any item again, -
- Please reduce your weight, -
- And come back again later! -
scripts.translation:
- 請等一下！！-
- 您攜帶的物品太多，無法再接收物品。-
- 請減輕負重後再來！-

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
I am Designer Heidam, who has all kinds of cool costumes in the World.
If you have any Kitcoins with you, come look for Designer Heidam!
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
我是設計師海丹，世界上各式各樣的酷炫時裝，我這裡都有。
帶著貓幣來找海丹就對了！

scripts.text: Exchange costume for random enchant box
scripts.translation: 用時裝兌換隨機附魔盒

scripts.text: Continue conversation
scripts.translation: 繼續對話

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Though I look out of shape right now, I used to be a well known fashion model and designer!
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
別看我現在身材走樣，以前我可是出名的時裝模特兼設計師！

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Don't pity me! I am well aware of my looks, but I like who I am inside.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
別同情我！我很清楚自己的外表，但我喜歡內在的自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This item is useless to me! Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這件物品對我沒用！你還有別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Oh, then I can exchange it for a box of costume enchantment items.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
哦，那我可以把它換成一盒時裝附魔道具。

scripts.text: - Rummaging -
scripts.translation: - 翻找中 -

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
I see that you have a ^3131FF{0}^000000. Do you want to exchange this for a costume enchantment box?
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
我看到你有一個^3131FF{0}^000000。你想用它兌換一個時裝附魔盒嗎？

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Look for something else
scripts.translation: 找點別的

scripts.text: Stop Exchanging
scripts.translation: 停止兌換

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Oh~ Something suddenly disappeared...
Let me check you for another item to exchange...
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
咦~東西怎麼突然不見了...
我再看看你有沒有別的東西可以換...

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Exchange Completed.
Let me check you for another item to exchange...
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
兌換完成。
我再看看你有沒有別的東西可以換...

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Meow? Where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
喵？你要去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Guess that is all.
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
看來就這些了。

scripts.text: Look more
scripts.translation: 再看看

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Designer Heidam]
Bye~
scripts.translation:
[設計師 海丹]
再見~

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Welcome to Fashion Stone!!
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
歡迎光臨時尚石！！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
We take various costume items.
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
我們回收各種時裝物品。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
If you want cool styling for your costume, please come to me 'Aver De Dosh'!
Don't forget to bring ^ff0000your own costume and costume stones^000000~
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
想讓時裝造型更酷炫，就來找我阿維爾·德·多什！
記得帶上^ff0000時裝和對應的附魔石^000000~

scripts.text: Apply enchant.
scripts.translation: 進行附魔

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Please check our other upgrading services~
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
請檢視我們的其他升級服務~

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
Kiaaaaach!!!
I hate bulging bags!
No matter how cool your costume looks, that fat bag of yours is a fashion terror you know!
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
呀啊啊！！！我最討厭鼓鼓囊囊的背包！
時裝穿得再酷，背上這麼個大包，也是時尚災難啊！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
It seems you have too many items on you.
Come back after clearing some inventory space.
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
看來你身上的物品太多了。
請清理一些背包空間後再來。

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
You must wear the costume you want to enchant.
Then, I will be able to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[阿維爾·德·多什]
你必須穿上想要附魔的時裝。
這樣我才能幫你。

scripts.text:

Well...

Wow... Elegance!!
This is perfect... Wow!
scripts.translation:

這太完美了...哇！

scripts.text:
[Aver De Dosh]
History is known for failure...
Just like the history of fashion...
Sorry...to disappoint you..~ LoL.

歷史總少不了失敗...
時尚的歷史也是如此...
抱歉...讓你失望了~哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Lace La Zard]
Welcome to Fashion Stone!!
My name is Lace La Zard who will make your 'Power Shoulder' dream come true.
scripts.translation:

我是蕾絲·拉·扎德，幫你實現“氣場十足的肩部造型”之夢！

scripts.text:

Bring your ^ff0000Costume Garment^000000 and ^ff0000Garment Stone^000000, I will complete the perfect upgrade for you.!
I found this formula while working on my own humble body upgrading!
scripts.translation:

帶上你的^ff0000時裝披肩^000000和^ff0000披肩附魔石^000000，我來為你完成完美強化！
這可是我琢磨怎麼改造自己這副小身板時，發現的配方！
